orthography_pronunciation.voice_strategy: Synthetic ro-RO browser voice, explicitly labelled; never claim native recording.

nominal: three genders with neuter singular/plural behaviour
definite article suffixed to the noun
pe-marked differential object and clitic doubling
syntax_discourse: relatively flexible order and clitic placement

register_pragmatics: Romanian/Moldovan regional naming handled according to canonical inventory
diaspora contexts without duplicate language entities

CEFR_progression.A1: sound-spelling, introductions, articles, present and basic objects
CEFR_progression.A2: compound perfect, quantity, directions, future and polite requests
CEFR_progression.B1: imperfect/perfect contrast, subjunctive, relative clauses and narration
CEFR_progression.B2: clitic doubling, conditional, passive/reflexive, information structure and register
CEFR_progression.C1: academic nominal style, synthesis, mediation, stance
CEFR_progression.C2: scope, implication, rhetoric, idiom, genre transformation and epistemic precision
